ns2:course.label: Advanced Diabetes Management
ns2:course.description: Discuss current topics in advanced diabetes management for nutrition professionals who plan to work directly in patient care, research, and administrative roles with patients with diabetes. 3 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: FSHN 420.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: FSHN 420.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Food Science & Human Nutrition or Nutritional Sciences department.
